title: CustomMetadataDef
description: Definition of a custom metadata structure (also known as BusinessMetadataDef). Custom metadata allows organizations to define their own attributes that can be attached to any asset type. Managed via the /api/meta/types/typedefs endpoint. Note: 'CustomMetadataDef' and 'BusinessMetadataDef' refer to the same concept - the API uses 'businessMetadataDefs' in requests/responses.

properties.name: category
properties.description: Type category. Always 'BUSINESS_METADATA' for custom metadata.

properties.name: guid
properties.description: Globally unique identifier for this custom metadata definition.

properties.name: name
properties.description: Internal hashed-string name of the custom metadata (e.g., 'WqZ3Tz9DdN2fB7mK'). Use this value when attaching custom metadata to assets via the API.

properties.name: displayName
properties.description: Human-readable name displayed in the Atlan UI.

properties.name: description
properties.description: Description of what this custom metadata represents.

properties.name: attributeDefs
properties.description: Attributes defined in this custom metadata structure. Each attribute has a name, displayName, typeName, and options.

properties.name: options
properties.description: Visual options for the custom metadata badge display.

properties.name: options.logoType
properties.description: Type of logo to display: 'icon', 'emoji', or 'image'.

properties.name: options.iconName
properties.description: Phosphor icon name when logoType is 'icon' (e.g., 'PhDatabase').

properties.name: version
properties.description: Numeric version counter, incremented on each update.

properties.name: createTime
properties.description: Epoch timestamp (milliseconds) when this custom metadata was created.

properties.name: updateTime
properties.description: Epoch timestamp (milliseconds) when this custom metadata was last updated.

properties.name: createdBy
properties.description: Username or service account that created this custom metadata.

properties.name: updatedBy
properties.description: Username or service account that last updated this custom metadata.
